explanation: Recursively compare taking either endpoint. Assume the opponent chooses the next endpoint that leaves the smaller future revenue, and store interval results in a table.
timeComplexity: O(n²) when nonempty interval revenues are nonzero; zero-valued memo states can be recomputed exponentially
